summary.text: Dru Kanuha was elected to the Hawaii State Senate in 2018 to represent Kona and Kaʻū.

paragraphs.text: Kanuha was elected to the Hawaiʻi County Council in 2012, served two re-elected terms, and in 2014 was chosen by fellow members as the first Council Chair from Kona.
Born in Kealakekua and raised in Hōlualoa, Kanuha earned a degree in Political Science and Business Administration from the University of San Diego.
